description: Resumable tracker for finishing windowsweep to 100% feature-complete and production-ready. The first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on. The specification for every RW- item is remaining-work.md at the repository root; this file is the ONLY status record.

userDecisions.docsSite: in scope: aoneahsan/windowsweep-docs at windowsweep-docs.aoneahsan.com, Docusaurus on GitHub Pages (owner, 2026-09-03)
userDecisions.desktopApp: a later, separate phase (P6): Tauri wrapper around the same script, like macleanup/desktop; not counted toward CLI completion; account model decided when the phase opens (owner, 2026-09-03)
userDecisions.distribution: npm and git clone only; no winget, Scoop, Chocolatey or PowerShell Gallery (owner, 2026-09-03)
userDecisions.releases: every release from 1.0.1 on gets an annotated git tag vX.Y.Z and a GitHub Release; v1.0.0 is tagged retroactively on 70c6738
userDecisions.accountModel: desktop app: optional Google sign-in for sync only (email, settings, run history); runs are never gated, no paid tier, no plan set - explicit owner exemption (owner, 2026-09-03)
userDecisions.telemetry: desktop app: full fleet observability (GA4 + Amplitude + Clarity + Sentry) behind a first-run consent dialog, every provider off until accepted; the CLI keeps zero network calls (owner, 2026-09-03)
userDecisions.toolchainDownloads: no toolchain or dependency-tree downloads on this machine until the owner's go-ahead; CI compiles meanwhile (owner, 2026-09-03) - PENDING-TASKS.md TASK-001, MANUAL-TASKS row 14
userDecisions.desktopLocation: desktop/ in this repository (macleanup pattern); releases desktop-vX.Y.Z with latest.json; identifier com.aoneahsan.windowsweep (permanent); app version equals the bundled CLI version
userDecisions.palette: primary hue 128 (lime): light #4d7c0f, dark #a3e635 with dark on-accent text; 24 degrees from taxease 104 and wakalat 152, the widest gap left; success moves to 158; free treatments sky 231 and plum 320; the logo mark keeps its sky-blue gradient
userDecisions.adminSurface: user emails and run history are administered in the Firebase console for phase P6; a web admin panel is a later separate phase (recorded deviation from the platform-admin rule)
userDecisions.unverifiedTargets: verified only: a path becomes a target once it has been seen on a real machine; everything unverifiable is a documented candidate table in docs/sections.md plus one MANUAL-TASKS probe row (owner, 2026-09-04)
userDecisions.sessionOrder: after 1.1.0 ships, continue straight into P6-A on Opus - no review round in between (owner, 2026-09-04)

runHistory.summary: Full audit of main at 84c732f against the plan, the siblings and npm; owner decisions on scope, docs site, desktop app and distribution; remaining-work.md, remaining-work-summary.md, what-this-project-consists-of.md and this tracker written; records refreshed

RW-002 to RW-011 fixed (--yes never selects in sections 17-19, recycle tier, purge-all typed confirm, VSIX cache split out, npx installer refusal, engine exit 130, uninstall-data always asks, 12 keywords); new modules/self_test_extra.ps1 group [12] with 4 checks, self-test 108 -> 114; RW-053 CI tarball sweep; session-3 decisions recorded. Release commit for 1.0.1

windowsweep@1.0.1 published to npm (38 files, 81.4 kB packed, 273.1 kB unpacked, built from edaa5cf); publish gate ran in full including a content-regression diff against the 1.0.0 tarball (no file lost, one added) and a smoke-install of the packed tarball (114/114). Verified with npm view = 1.0.1 and npx -y windowsweep@1.0.1 from %TEMP%. Annotated tags v1.0.0 (70c6738) and v1.0.1 (edaa5cf) pushed with GitHub Releases for both

Self-test groups [13] and [14]: argument parser, section-id list, docker size text, the cache-leaf guard, the --json shape, superseded versions, the Chromium layout, workspace storage, stale artefacts and the report exporters. Test-KnownCacheLeaf and Get-JsonSummary refactored out for direct exercise. 114 -> 124 checks; all six plants proved red, and the stale-artefact fixture was rebuilt after its first plant stayed green (it was half-oriented)

Documentation site aoneahsan/windowsweep-docs built from the linux-cleanup-docs template: 15 mirrored pages with front matter, lime palette, JSON-LD rewritten for Windows/PowerShell, Pages workflow with an owner-only-file sweep (proved failing on a planted pattern), ruleset copied, CNAME pinned. Three real defects fixed on the way: the inherited lockfile entry was unsorted (YN0028), robots.txt still advertised the linux-cleanup sitemap, and unquoted front-matter descriptions containing a colon broke the YAML parse. AI-INTEGRATION-GUIDE.md written, verified command by command, shipped in the tarball and mirrored

Repository hygiene and the owner records: 8 topics, wiki off; FilesHub project 60 (slug windowsweep) created for the phase-P6 vault; palette hue 128 (lime) registered with the no-free-arc reasoning recorded, and ports 5972/5973/5974 claimed; portfolio-info file plus an identical root copy, the master links entry, windowsweep.bib and the combined refresh, and the ORCID block in both instruction files
WH003 written; CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md refreshed with the new state and stack rows for the docs site and the desktop app; PENDING-TASKS.md pointer added; memory and the plan execution log updated

Sections 22-25 added (globals audit, orphaned AppData, idle programs, startup items); --select/--select-file, --notify, candidates[]/targets[]/progress lines and --list --json; the Hugging Face and wsreset rows and seven artefact-dir additions. Target collection is driven by the catalogue instead of a literal 0..21. Self-test 124 -> 151, every new check proved red on its own plant. Three real defects the new checks found: a HashSet returned unrolled made the section-23 exclusions case-sensitive, section 24 measured last-access so it could never report anything, and a $p/$P case collision nulled the roots table

resumeInstructions: 1) Read CLAUDE.md, remaining-work.md and this tracker. 2) Find the first pending sub-task (owner rows are blocked + awaitingUser: prepare, never execute). 3) Do that item or phase only, obeying the IRON rules. 4) Run the item's gates. 5) Flip the sub-task in the same commit as the work, bump lastUpdated, append a runHistory row with the SHA. 6) One commit, push to o main, quote any 'Bypassed rule violations' line.
